name: analyze_code_block_tool
description: Specialized tool for analyzing code block images to extract and document code structure and syntax patterns. ONLY use for: code snippets, programming examples, source code screenshots, syntax highlighting examples, code documentation, algorithm implementations, and any visual representation of programming code. NOT for: diagrams, tables, handwriting, or non-code content. If no code block is found, returns that no code content was detected and suggests checking with user for appropriate tool selection.

image_path.description: S3 URL (s3://bucket/key) or absolute file path to the image. Use this OR image_data, not both.

image_data.description: Base64-encoded image data. Use this OR image_path, not both. Preferred when image is already in memory.

aws_profile.description: Optional AWS profile name for Bedrock authentication. If not provided, uses default AWS credentials

job_id.description: Identifier of the analysis run this invocation belongs to. Pass through the job_id supplied in the orchestrator context. Omit only when no analysis run is active.

doc_id.description: Identifier of the source document being analysed. Pass through the doc_id supplied in the orchestrator context.

result.description: Analysis result from Code Block Specialist
